entities.name: Ferenc Sebő
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferenc Sebő is a Hungarian folklorist and musician, best known as the bandleader for the Sebő Ensemble, a band that produced many future stars, including Márta Sebestyén. The Sebő Ensemble was one of the best-known groups of the Hungarian roots revival in the 1970s.
